scenes.text: Wasting time at a goal kick? Five seconds, or it's a corner to the other team.
Change one: if you delay a goal kick or a throw-in, the referee whistles a five-second countdown. A late goal kick becomes a corner. A late throw-in goes to the opponents.
Two: the player coming off has ten seconds to leave the pitch. If not, the replacement waits outside for at least a minute.
Three: you're fouled on an obvious goal-scoring chance, the referee plays advantage and you score. No card any more.
Four: an accidental double touch at a penalty. If it goes in, it's retaken.
And five: VAR can now correct a clearly wrong second yellow card.
And heads up: from July 2027, only the captain may approach the referee.
Save it, and share it with whoever still argues by the old rules.
